raw_description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.
title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
